_about: Crops of the mine world (Docs/MineFarming.md). stages counts the ripe one; stage_hours is in-game hours a stage at full rate (full sun, wet, rich soil). dry_rate: the rate on dry farmland. light: the light it wants (0-1; open sky is 1). drain: fertility a harvest takes; restores: fertility it gives back. likes/dislikes: biome names. yield and seeds_back: [min, max] a harvest. regrow_to: a perennial goes back to this stage when harvested (-1: replant). found: breaking these blocks by hand in survival may give the seed.

wheat.name: Wheat
wheat.tips: The easy first crop. Wants open sky and water near it; dry soil slows it to under half speed. Give back seeds as well as grain, so a field keeps itself going.

carrot.name: Carrot
carrot.tips: Planted from a carrot, so keep one back. Copes with a little shade and some dryness. Likes cool meadows.

potato.name: Potato
potato.tips: The hardiest food crop: grows in shade and on dry soil better than any other, but it is hungry -- it takes the most out of the soil. Plant beans after it.

beans.name: Beans
beans.tips: Puts fertility BACK into the soil every harvest. Grow them where a hungry crop (potatoes, pumpkins) has worn the soil out.

pumpkin.name: Pumpkin
pumpkin.tips: Slow and thirsty: on dry soil it barely grows, so dig it next to water. Wants full sun and rich soil, and takes a lot out of it. A well kept pumpkin gives extra seeds.

corn.name: Corn
corn.tips: Tall, thirsty and hungry, but the biggest grain harvest. Planted from a cob. Rotate it with beans to keep the soil up.

cabbage.name: Cabbage
cabbage.tips: The quickest crop and the only leaf crop: fine in shade, light on the soil. Good between hungrier crops in a rotation.

melon.name: Melon
melon.tips: The thirstiest crop of all: on dry soil it hardly grows. Warm, sunny, wet and rich soil, then a big green melon.

oak_tree.name: Oak sapling
oak_tree.tips: Planted on grass or dirt (no hoe needed). When grown it becomes a real tree: fell it for wood and leaves, and maybe a new sapling.

dark_oak_tree.name: Dark oak sapling
dark_oak_tree.tips: A dark-leaved tree that copes with shade and cold. Planted on grass or dirt; grows into a real tree.

birch_tree.name: Birch sapling
birch_tree.tips: The quickest tree. Planted on grass or dirt; grows into a real tree.

acacia_tree.name: Acacia sapling
acacia_tree.tips: The tallest tree, slow, and happy dry. Planted on grass or dirt; grows into a real tree.

berry_bush.name: Berry bush
berry_bush.tips: Plant once, pick for ever: after a harvest the bush keeps its leaves and only grows the berries again. Happy in shade, cold and on dry soil.
